query: INSERT INTO health_reminders(user_id,hour_utc,next_send) VALUES($1,$2,date_trunc('day',now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' + $2::smallint * interval '1 hour' + CASE WHEN extract(hour FROM now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') >= $2 THEN interval '1 day' ELSE interval '0 days' END) ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO UPDATE SET hour_utc=EXCLUDED.hour_utc,next_send=EXCLUDED.next_send
